storage: Keep in an airtight jar in a cool place; refrigerate in hot, humid Mumbai weather to slow rancidity.
looksLike: Pale cream, kidney- or comma-shaped nuts with a smooth surface and a mildly sweet, buttery taste.
howToPick: Even cream colour, whole nuts, a sweet mild smell. Avoid yellowed, oily-smelling (rancid) or shrivelled nuts.
shelfLife: About 4 to 6 months at room temperature in a sealed pack, longer in the fridge (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
mergeNotes: Range 927.9–1313.1 was wider than 30% of avg 1109.3; narrowed to ±15%.
